lines.text: Many learners say: Can you give me some informations?
Better: Can you give me some information?

data.wrong: Can you give me some informations?
data.right: Can you give me some information?

native.tip: information 是不可数名词，后面不加 s。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “Can you give me some informations?”？😅 information 是不可数名词，不能加 s：“Can you give me some information?”。跟着 Ama 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。
native.comment: 答案：“information”。information 不可数！免费测验在这里：{link}

en.tip: Information is uncountable, so never add an s.
en.caption: Do you say “Can you give me some informations?”? 😅 Information is uncountable, so it never takes an s: “Can you give me some information?”. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
